title: SKE Crystal Pineapple Peach Mango Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Pineapple Peach Mango flavour SKE Crystal Nic Salts e-liquid is a tantalizing combination of tropical pineapple, ripe peach, and juicy mango, delivering a rich and fruity vape that's bursting with flavour. This exotic mix is perfect for vapers seeking a sweet, flavourful escape in every puff. As part of the SKE Crystal Nic Salts range, this e-liquid uses nicotine salts to ensure a smooth vaping experience with minimal throat hit, making it ideal for those transitioning from smoking. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio offers excellent flavour and vapour production, suitable for various mouth-to-lung vaping devices. SKE are the creators of the hugely popular SKE Crystal Bar 600 disposable vape, a super-convenient single-use vape bar encased in a dazzling crystal chassis. SKE have since expanded their range with the SKE Crystal Plus pre-filled pod kit as well as this ever-evolving collection of Nicotine Salt 10ml e-liquids for use with many kinds of vape kit.
